official.description: Poland My First Choice Programme is a NAWA scholarship programme for international students from 45 eligible countries and territories who want to study in Poland. The beneficiary is awarded a scholarship during the statutory period of full-time second-cycle studies at public and non-public higher education institutions supervised by the Minister of Science and Higher Education, and, in the case of public universities, an exemption from tuition fees. Participants choose their university and field of study independently, and NAWA does not act as an intermediary in admission.
official.program_type: State agency scholarship programme for incoming international master's students

applicant_utility.summary: This programme gives you freedom of choice: NAWA explicitly does not act as an intermediary in admission, so you pick the Polish university and the second-cycle programme yourself, apply to that institution for admission, and participate in the scholarship route published in the call. What you get is a scholarship for the statutory period of your studies plus, at a public university, tuition-fee exemption, but the programme page never states a monthly amount or that living costs are covered, so do not commit on the assumption of a stipend. Be aware that NAWA says its work plan for the programme is under revision, and the call link from the previous cycle is dead, so you need to watch the NAWA programmes schedule for the next call rather than relying on a stored deadline.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Incoming master's applicants from the 45 eligible NAWA countries and territories who have a specific Polish public university and second-cycle programme in mind and can fund their own living costs.
